# Explain which required details are missing before saving

## What & Why
Incomplete forms currently stay open through browser validation, but users do not get app-specific guidance about what needs attention. Clear inline messages would make the answer and application flows easier to recover from, especially for keyboard and assistive-technology users.

## Done looks like
- Answer forms identify the missing title or answer content when save is attempted
- Application forms identify whether company or role is missing
- Validation messages are associated with their fields and disappear once the form is valid
